taskVersion.name: ves-heldout-item

parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station H-03, survey area H. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 193.6 | 0.90 | 0.90
2 | 129.1 | 3.18 | 4.08
3 | 29.1 | 0.79 | 4.87
4 | 29.8 | 26.64 | 31.51
5 | 165.4 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as QQA-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station H-03, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Site Note – Station H-03, Survey Area H**

The interpreted model comprises five layers. Resistivity decreases from 193.6 Ω·m (Layer 1) to 129.1 Ω·m (Layer 2) to 29.1 Ω·m (Layer 3), then rises slightly to 29.8 Ω·m (Layer 4), and increases markedly to 165.4 Ω·m (Layer 5, inferred basement/substratum). Total depth to the base of Layer 4 is 31.51 m.

Applying the standard curve-type convention to the resistivity sequence:
- Layers 1-2-3: r1 > r2 > r3 → Q
- Layers 2-3-4: r2 > r3 < r4 → H
- Layers 3-4-5: r3 < r4 < r5 → A

This gives a curve type of **QHA**, not the **QQA** recorded in the file. The on-file classification does not match the tabulated resistivity values and should be corrected or re-verified before further use in cross-station correlation.

{"curve_type_stated": "QHA", "label_issue_flagged": true}
